data.name: Fakhriyah
data.gender_notes: Fakhriyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Fakhriyah is derived from the Arabic word 'Fakhr', which means 'pride' or 'honor'. It signifies someone who takes pride in their achievements, their family, or their faith. The name Fakhriyah carries the meaning “Proud and Honorable” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Fakhriyah usually hope their child will grow to embody proud and honorable and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Being proud and honorable in the sight of Allah is the ultimate goal of a Muslim. Fakhriyah symbolizes this noble character trait.
data.etymology: Fakhriyah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Proud and Honorable.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fakhriyah total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.cultural_impact: Fakhriyah is a beautiful and unique name that demonstrates the importance of self-worth and accomplishment within the Islamic community. In many Muslim cultures, honor and pride are integral aspects of identity and family, and the name Fakhriyah is a constant reminder of these values. It is a name that can inspire individuals to strive for excellence and take pride in their achievements, instilling a sense of self-worth and confidence.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Fakhriyah carries a deeper meaning, reminding us of the importance of finding pride and honor in our faith and connection to Allah. In Islamic teachings, expressing pride in one's relationships with family, friends, and community is encouraged, but true pride and honor come from recognizing and submitting to the greater power of Allah. Fakhriyah signifies not just external pride and achievements, but an internal sense of worth and contentment that is rooted in one's relationship with Allah.
